targetTexts.1: Of Solomon. Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
targetTexts.2: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.
targetTexts.3: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.
targetTexts.4: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
targetTexts.5: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.
targetTexts.6: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
targetTexts.7: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound until the moon is no more.
targetTexts.8: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
targetTexts.9: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
targetTexts.10: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
targetTexts.11: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
targetTexts.12: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
targetTexts.13: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
targetTexts.14: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
targetTexts.15: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
targetTexts.16: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, the people of its cities like the grass of the field.
targetTexts.17: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
targetTexts.18: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
targetTexts.19: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.
targetTexts.20: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
